mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, type, title, body, ref_type, ref_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{body}, #{refType}, #{refId})
mapper.select: SELECT guard_id FROM guard_senior WHERE senior_id = #{seniorId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT u.fcm_token FROM guard_senior gs JOIN users u ON u.user_id = gs.guard_id WHERE gs.senior_id = #{seniorId} AND gs.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.fcm_token IS NOT NULL
SELECT fcm_token FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND fcm_token IS NOT NULL

SELECT w.user_id AS wardId, t.amount AS amount, r.holder_name AS recipientName FROM transactions t JOIN wallets w ON w.wallet_id = t.wallet_id LEFT JOIN recipients r ON r.recipient_id = t.recipient_id WHERE t.transaction_id = #{transactionId}
